# Detector error analysis (generated by scripts/detector_error_analysis.py; do not edit by hand)

Model: YOLO11m (the dashboard detector), 1280 px letterbox input, NMS IoU 0.7, detections kept at confidence 0.10 and above. A detection is a true positive when its IoU with a not-yet-matched ground-truth box of the same class is at least 0.5 (highest confidence first). Operating point for recall and precision: confidence 0.25, the dashboard default.

These numbers come from our own matching code on the saved detections. They are not the Ultralytics mAP numbers in docs/RESULTS.md (those use confidence 0.001, NMS IoU 0.6 and 101-point interpolation), so AP50 here is expected to differ from them.

## Test split (22040 ground-truth boxes, 744 images)

Own mAP50 over the 13 classes: 0.203. At confidence 0.25: 16955 detections, precision 40.9%, class-aware recall 31.5%.
Ground-truth boxes found by any detection (IoU 0.5, class ignored): 49.2% at confidence 0.25 and 70.7% at 0.10. Among the boxes found at 0.25, the best-overlapping detection has the right class in 61.5% of cases.

## Validation split (24643 ground-truth boxes, 744 images)

Own mAP50 over the 13 classes: 0.238. At confidence 0.25: 17376 detections, precision 45.0%, class-aware recall 31.8%.
Ground-truth boxes found by any detection (IoU 0.5, class ignored): 47.0% at confidence 0.25 and 66.8% at 0.10. Among the boxes found at 0.25, the best-overlapping detection has the right class in 65.0% of cases.

## Reading the test-split numbers

- Of all ground-truth boxes, 50.8% have no detection at all at confidence 0.25 (missed or not localised), and a further 17.7% are localised but carry the wrong class or lose the match to another box; the remaining 31.5% are correctly found and classified.
- Small boxes are 89.6% of the test boxes and class-aware recall on them is 30.5%, against 38.7% for large boxes.
- Highest own AP50: pet_bottle (0.407); lowest: other_string (0.020).
- These are one model, one training run and one matching rule (IoU 0.5); do not read small differences between classes as established.

## Plausibility check

Own test mAP50 0.203 against the Ultralytics test mAP50 0.252 for the same model: OK. A moderate gap is expected because of the different confidence floor, NMS threshold and interpolation.
Ground-truth totals match the dataset counts (val 24,643 and test 22,040).
